Author: Tihlyn
Name: MahjongHater
Punchline: Doman Mahjong advisor: discard, call and riichi recommendations with reasoning.
Description: Reads the Doman Mahjong (Emj) table straight from the game and runs a decision policy over it: recommended discard, call, riichi or win, ranked alternatives with deal-in risk, and the reasoning behind each step. Highlights the recommended tile in the game UI.
